title: Catalog redirection state
statement: For a type $S$, a Boolean $b$, an optional state $q$ of $S$, and an optional Boolean $r$, define a redirected state as follows: if $q$ is present, it is the pair $(q,r)$ in the left summand; if $q$ is absent, it is absent when $r=b$, and otherwise it is the unique element of the right summand.
